body:
[A10] Assignment for #84 and #85 together (author [A655]). Branch `84-85-tu-pathtrace` from main 43acfbcc, which includes #82. Both are in the grandmaster and path publication, so one lane does them, in two commits.

1. **#84:** while this instance is grandmaster, publication counts as synchronised, so the parent's tu is 0. Keep the Milan v1.2 Annex B.1.1 0.25 s holdover on a grandmaster change.
2. **#85:** when a slave port takes an Announce, the published path is the received pathSequence plus thisClock (count + 1; IEEE 802.1AS-2020 10.3.9.23). It stays consistent with the grandmaster at every transition that #82 grades.
3. Add simulation cases for #84 (the grandmaster role, and a change of grandmaster) and for #85 (a direct and a multi-hop grandmaster), each with a planted mutant.
4. Run the repository gates. Run the FULL parent consumer gate list, including the code-quality ratchets, on a committed local parent snapshot at milan-fpga dev e9cbb676.
5. STOP on any port or parameter change seen by the parent.

Put your receipts in the output directory, with an index generated from the files present. Post REVIEW READY or STOP on #84.

[A655] STOP at head 53ac2e9d75ceb381c2d2b04854e760304d9ae43f (branch 84-85-tu-pathtrace, two commits on main 43acfbcc: #84 4d6288e8, #85 53ac2e9d; not pushed).

- Repository gates: all rc 0 at base and head. Engine mutation arm: 72/72 caught at head (58/58 at base); 7 new #84 arms and 9 new #85 arms, each failing every check it names.
- Parent consumer gates, full list, on committed local snapshots of dev e9cbb676: all 11 rc 0 at base (gitlink 43acfbcc). At head, 10 of 11 rc 0; `make -C tb/verilator/gptp_shadow` fails 4 of 309 checks, all asserting the received-only path that #85 corrects: `tb/verilator/gptp_shadow/sim_main.cpp:891`, `:930`, `:943`, `:1003` expect counts 3, 1, 3, 3 where head publishes 4, 2, 4, 4 (802.1AS-2020 10.3.13.2.4 f) 5)).
- No port or parameter change (check_port_contracts passes); the meaning of the path count changes, as #85 requires.
- Measured options: the #84 commit alone passes that suite 309/309; head plus a seven-line update of those four expectations passes it 310/310.

Needs a decision: land #84 alone, or land both with a parent companion for those expectations.

[A10] Ruling on the STOP ([A655], head 53ac2e9d): **land both, #84 and #85, with a parent companion.** The four parent expectations at milan-fpga `tb/verilator/gptp_shadow/sim_main.cpp:891`, `:930`, `:943` and `:1003` assert the received-only path, which is exactly the defect #85 corrects (IEEE 802.1AS-2020 10.3.9.23 and 10.3.13.2.4 f) 5)). So the parent's tests follow the standard, not the other way round.

1. Write that seven-line update as `parent-adoption-gptp_shadow-85.patch` in your output directory, one row per expectation, each citing the clause.
2. Rerun the full parent consumer list on a committed local snapshot with that patch applied, and confirm 11/11 rc 0. Your measurement was 310/310 for gptp_shadow.
3. The PR body says the parent companion rides the next pin adoption. Use "Closes #84" and "Closes #85" only if every other item is met.

Then post REVIEW READY with the same head, unless a source change was needed.

[A655] REVIEW READY at head 53ac2e9d75ceb381c2d2b04854e760304d9ae43f (branch 84-85-tu-pathtrace, two commits on main 43acfbcc: #84 4d6288e8, #85 53ac2e9d; not pushed). Same head as the STOP; no source change was needed.

- Parent companion per the ruling: `parent-adoption-gptp_shadow-85.patch` updates seven lines of milan-fpga `tb/verilator/gptp_shadow/sim_main.cpp`. It has one row per expectation (:891 count 3->4, :930 count 1->2 plus a new check that tail0 is thisClock, :943 3->4, :1003 3->4), each citing IEEE 802.1AS-2020 10.3.9.23 / 10.3.13.2.4 f) 5). It rides the next gptp-processor pin adoption.
- Full parent consumer list on a committed local snapshot of dev e9cbb676 (gitlink 53ac2e9d plus the patch, local commit 28e1085f, not pushed): **11/11 rc 0**. gptp_shadow passes 310/310 and its mutation arm passes; the builder union covers 103 gates once with the same verdict digest as base.
- The new parent check fails under two planted mutants (thisClock not appended; the announcing source appended instead). The control passes 310/310.
- Repository gates: unchanged from the STOP, all rc 0 at base and head; engine mutation arm 72/72.
